scripts.check: pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:ui && pnpm check:distribution && pnpm check:repo
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -q -- -D warnings && mise x -- cargo nextest run --locked --cargo-quiet --status-level fail && mise x -- cargo machete
scripts.check:ui: biome check --error-on-warnings . && tsc -p ui && node ui/scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node ui/scripts/check-copy.mjs && node ui/scripts/check-formatters.mjs && knip --no-progress && pnpm --filter @listenee-ltm/ui check:copy-screens
scripts.check:repo: mise x -- typos && mise x -- cargo deny check -s && mise x -- gitleaks git --log-opts=--all --redact --no-banner -l warn . && pnpm audit --audit-level moderate && mise x -- actionlint
